questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: The destination was determined by my Masters degree

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Compare to University of Copenhagen - getting information at University of Milan was difficult. There was a lot of missinformation and desorganisation

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Most of the needed assistance was conected to the specific for my degree requirements and rules

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: It was difficult to find something in the areas considered to be safe, close to university and for a good price.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Most of the rooms/ apartments is managed by private companies. You have to make sure that you will have enough money to cover moing in/moving out fees, deposit and rent. Try to minimalize the chance to be scammed (Erasmus gran is not enough to cover everything, make sure to have some savings and to document well the condition of the place youre moving into).

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: No housing was available (dorms provided by university have crazy rules on family income and overall financial stability, which is hard to prove when youre coming from abroad)

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: For my degree most of the courses were mandatory and registration process was almost automatic.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: online platform for contact and the head of studies in Milan

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: It was very successful

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Hard to say, my experience was different from most of the Erasmus students

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: There were some dissapointments - for example some of the clases were called laboratories but it had nothing to do with exerimental/practical work

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: As someone who has a background in environmental engineering - the classes were unfortunately repetition of what I had during my bachelors

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Hard to say, style of teaching dependend on the professor both at UNIMI and UCPH

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 2 semesters

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: theatre, cinema, social gatherings

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: joining student organisation (like ESN). They offer a lot of different activities and opportunity to socialize

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: walking around the city, checking out small random streets and area outside of Milan - any direction, just take a train and go

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was very easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Unfortunately, Ive meet mostly exchange students - not local

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: organization culture is very different and can be quite annoying

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: being open and sincere

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. Be ready to spend more than you think 
2. Be patient, everything at UNIMI takes more time than you think and probobaly will work in a different way than you expect 
3. It can be a beautiful and fun experience but also frustrating - be ready for that

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Meeting amazing friends, form whom Im super grateful

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: organization from the side of University (for other students, who are not doing a double degree it might be actually easier)

Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
